rule: Names: a letter-level generator (length 3 + 0-4, with a 1-in-5 longer tail; space allowed in the middle 4 times in 5; vowel after consonant always, after a vowel-consonant pair 2 in 5; consonant clusters 2 in 7 from begin, middle and end pools) seeded per item, so the same seed gives the same name. Artefact name: a table name for some base types by coin flip, else base + ' of X' (1 in 3) or base + quoted X (2 in 3), display width capped at 25. Randart budget: quality = 1 + Binomial(6, 21%), bad = Binomial(2, 21%), good = quality + bad, distinct properties capped at 4 (+1 at 1/20, +1 at 1/40), extra good points raise existing properties, properties drawn by weight with no repeats, each property with a max duplicate count and odds step. Glyph grammar: SUBST maps a glyph to weighted replacements (plain char weight 10, c:N explicit), ':' freezes the first roll for the spec, '=' rolls per cell; each replacement wins with chance weight/running total (one pass). NSUBST takes exact counts of a key glyph after a shuffle, specs in order, '*' for the rest.
keep: Seed per item; derive the name from the seed (store the seed, not the name)
Budgeted properties: quality points, a small bad-roll budget, a cap on distinct properties, extra points raise existing ones
Weighted one-pass replacement for glyph layouts
Fixed roll per zone (':') versus per-cell roll ('=')
NSUBST-style exact count placement (one boss or chest per zone)
change: Letter-level names are often not pronounceable; use our word lists and a 14-character cap for one line at 375 wide
Mixed quoted and 'of' name forms: pick our own split
Scope of a fixed SUBST freeze is not traced; confirm it is per placement, not per game, before relying on it
look_test: Generate 10 items from 10 seeds with the donor's name shape and budget (quality 1-7, max four distinct properties). Show each as a 375-wide inspect card next to our current loot cards. Judge: name readable aloud, four property lines visible without scrolling, same seed gives the same name after reload. Target: src/fight/loot-roll.ts (new), parity row 18.
